study: Unchanged final CUDA PPO policy transfer under action-cadence and assumed-model sensitivity
design: All nine scenarios at55 decisions; nominal only at110. Eight policies on two physical grids per case:160 deterministic rollouts. No stochastic sampling, retraining, checkpoint selection or parameter fitting.
transfer: Reuse the final16384-step checkpoint from every seed unchanged. Recompute the existing six observations at each new action boundary; normalized progress and one/two-block lookahead follow the existing interface. At110 decisions the physical lookahead halves; this is cadence/interface transfer, not action duplication or a separately trained110-decision controller.
primary_endpoint: Fine-grid lap-time advantage against each scenario/cadence's strongest matched fixed baseline; retain all three seeds and summarize mean, sample SD and range. Numerical acceptance does not require a positive advantage.
secondary_endpoint: Paired110-minus55 nominal changes for each unchanged policy and baseline; model sensitivities are one parameter at a time at55 decisions. No interaction or uncertainty-distribution inference.
numerical_gate: Every rollout must satisfy boundary/reserve/cap/work-energy/battery identities. Each policy's absolute lap-time coarse/fine difference relative to the fine time must be<=0.5%, and its gain against its scenario/cadence's matching zero baseline must change by no more than0.05s between4400 and8800 physical cells. Nominal55 replay must reproduce saved source checkpoint durations, energies and actions exactly.
failure_policy: A new output directory is required. Preserve contract, partial traces, errors and hashes. Any missing/failed rollout, provenance mismatch, source mutation or numerical failure makes the study unaccepted; do not exclude failed seeds or average incomplete groups.
interpretation: Assumed-model deterministic feedback transfer only; sensitivities are declared perturbations, not calibrated uncertainty bounds. No convergence, statistical significance, optimum, real-car accuracy or empirical final-test claim. No telemetry is read. Retraining at another cadence requires a separate predeclared experiment.
